preconditions.description: Number of characters n is between 3 and 100,000.
Number of known relationships m is between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i and c_i in {0, 1} for a_i, b_i, c_i in relationships)
preconditions.description: Each relationship is described by two distinct characters a_i and b_i within the range [1, n], and a love/hate indicator c_i which is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to fill in the remaining relationships so that the speaker is happy with every triangle, modulo 1,000,000,007.
